close_reason: Added invariant comment to NormalizedIter::next pending_space state machine
description: The pending_space flag implementation is correct and handles leading/trailing/multiple-internal-space collapsing correctly. However, the coupling between the flag and position tracking (pos increments) is implicit. If a future maintainer extends this to handle other whitespace (tabs, NBSP) for v0.2 Unicode support, they could introduce double-emission or trailing-space bugs. Document the exact state machine invariant: 'after emitting a space, the next next() call must skip all consecutive space characters without advancing pos beyond non-space'. Add a comment block explaining the state transitions.
title: NormalizedIter: document state machine invariants for whitespace handling extensions
